request.text: Remind me at 6:30 this evening to start preheating the oven. Also look at me now and give one friendly blink so I know you heard me.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a 6:30 PM today reminder to start preheating the oven.
Give one friendly blink after orienting toward the user.

new_goals.description: Create a reminder for 6:30 PM today to start preheating the oven.
new_goals.source_text: Remind me at 6:30 this evening to start preheating the oven.
constraints: Schedule the reminder for 6:30 PM today.
Do not represent the reminder as operating the oven.
success_criteria: One reminder is created with the requested time and subject.

new_goals.description: Orient visual attention toward the user now.
constraints: Perform this before the requested blink.
success_criteria: The look-at-person action is planned before the blink action.

new_goals.description: Give one friendly blink after looking at the user.
new_goals.source_text: give one friendly blink so I know you heard me
constraints: Order the blink after orienting toward the user.
success_criteria: One blink is planned after the look-at-person action.

semantic_facts: The plan should cover all three canonical Goals: create the 6:30 PM reminder, look at the user now, and blink once after the look action.
The look and blink actions require explicit ordering, while reminder creation is independent and need not be serialized behind the embodied sequence.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims that it started or preheated the oven.
The blink is planned before looking at the user, repeated without basis, or used as a substitute for the reminder.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Three Goals are compressed into a generic acknowledgement that omits stateful or embodied Work.
The Planner either serializes unrelated reminder creation unnecessarily or loses the required ordering between gaze and blink.
